evals.prompt:
I want to import NetBox device types as object templates. Here
is the relevant part of our current schema, `schemas/dcim.yml`:

    ---
    version: "1.0"
    nodes:
      - name: Device
        namespace: Dcim
        label: Device
        inherit_from:
          - DcimGenericDevice
        attributes:
          - name: name
            kind: Text
            unique: true
          - name: serial
            kind: Text
            optional: true
        relationships:
          - name: interfaces
            peer: DcimInterface
            cardinality: many
            kind: Component
          - name: device_type
            peer: DcimDeviceType
            cardinality: one
            kind: Attribute

Work out what has to change in this schema before any converted
output can load, and write the corrected schema to
`./output_dir/dcim.yml` (create the directory). Explain the change in
a `./output_dir/notes.md`.
evals.expected_output: A ./output_dir/dcim.yml where the DcimDevice node carries generate_template: true, plus notes explaining that the Template* kinds do not exist until that flag is set and the schema is loaded.
expectations: The corrected schema sets generate_template true on the Device node
The flag is placed on the node, not on a generic
The notes explain that Template* kinds are generated, not hand-written
The notes note that only Component relationships generate component templates

assertions.name: generate-template-prerequisite
assertions.check: generate_template is set to true in the emitted schema or notes

evals.prompt:
Convert this NetBox device type for our OpsMill schema-library
DCIM schema (`generate_template: true` is enabled on `DcimDevice`).
Note that NetBox carries two free-text fields at the device-type level
and two per interface, while `DcimDeviceType` and `InterfacePhysical`
each have only a single `description` attribute.

    ---
    manufacturer: Cisco
    model: Catalyst 9200L-24T
    slug: cisco-c9200l-24t
    part_number: C9200L-24T-4G
    u_height: 1
    description: Fixed-uplink access switch for branch sites
    comments: '[Catalyst 9200 Data Sheet](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/switches/cat9200.html)'
    interfaces:
      - name: GigabitEthernet1/0/1
        type: 1000base-t
        label: Uplink A
        description: Primary uplink to the distribution layer
      - name: GigabitEthernet1/0/2
        type: 1000base-t
        label: Uplink B
      - name: GigabitEthernet1/0/3
        type: 1000base-t
        description: Spare access port
      - name: GigabitEthernet1/0/4
        type: 1000base-t

I do not want the datasheet URL ending up as the device type's
description, and I do not want to lose the interface text either.

Write the emitted files under `./output_dir/` (create the directory).
evals.expected_output: A ./output_dir/ where the device type description is the NetBox description (not the comments datasheet link), interfaces carry the NetBox description where present and fall back to the label where it is not, and the coverage report names the values lost to shadowing where both fields were set.
expectations: The device type description is the NetBox description, not the comments URL
GigabitEthernet1/0/1 takes its description from the NetBox description
GigabitEthernet1/0/2 falls back to its label because it has no description
GigabitEthernet1/0/3 takes its description with no label present
The coverage report names the shadowed comments and interface label values
Neither comments nor label is reported as an unmapped dropped field

assertions.name: envelope
assertions.check: Every emitted YAML doc has apiVersion, kind: Object, spec.kind, and spec.data list

assertions.name: template-kind
assertions.check: Templates are authored under a Template<Kind> and every row has a template_name

assertions.name: fallback-precedence
assertions.check: The semantic source wins, the fallback fills the gap, and shadowed values are named in the coverage report

assertions.name: coverage-report
assertions.check: A Markdown report names the NetBox component lists that did not convert
